parameters.name: Force
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to force delete the ASM instance. Valid values:

- `true`: Force deletes the ASM instance.

- `false`: Does not force delete the ASM instance.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: RetainResources
parameters.description: A JSON string that can be parsed into an array of strings. The array contains the instance IDs of the resources to retain when you delete the Service Mesh instance.
